items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: So, they had friends from New York. Harry Blake, and Kit Harris.

ctx.x: Oh, it was around 19, around 1970, something like that. Well, they went, they ran all the time, the 101 Ranch. So, they had friends from New York. Harry Blake, and Kit Harris. They were rich fellas. In other words, they ran cabarets up there, and they had their way, their way was gangsters. wild type fellas. Well, they came down, and they come by with Harry Parker, and Charlotte Parker. They come by and together, say they're going to buy a building. They bought a big building, right, across from the 101 Ranch, on…
